verses.1: A song of ascents. Of David. How good it is, how pleasant, where the people dwell as one!
verses.2: Like precious ointment on the head, running down upon the beard, Upon the beard of Aaron, upon the collar of his robe.
verses.3: Like dew of Hermon coming down upon the mountains of Zion. There the LORD has lavished blessings, life for evermore!

notes.text: The people: literally, "brothers," i.e., male and female members of a kin group or people - most probably, the people Israel.
Ointment: oil was used at the consecration of the high priest (Exodus 30:22-33).
Dew: dew was an important source of moisture in the dry climate (Genesis 27:28; Hosea 14:6). Hermon: the majestic snow-capped mountain visible in the north of Palestine.
